timestamp_alignment: exact 5-minute interval, current timestamp is final row

time_encoding.timezone: Dataset timestamps naive/local; simulation must use the same local clock convention

raw_missing_value_handling.offline: forward_fill only up to 2 consecutive 5-minute rows; no backward fill
raw_missing_value_handling.browser: keep last known value up to 2 missing 5-minute ticks, otherwise refuse inference
raw_missing_value_handling.window_validation: 12 consecutive timestamps, all 36 channels finite after bounded causal forward-fill

preprocessing.window_stats: mean/min/max, population std ddof=0; delta=last-previous; trend=(last-first)/11
preprocessing.scaler: Saved in ONNX graph if chosen model uses StandardScaler
preprocessing.imputer: Saved in ONNX graph; browser must reject absent/missing raw windows before feature calculation
